usedFor: A cancelled Shopify order cancels the matching booking in anny.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Update Booking Status” in anny
bestTemplate.why: It frees the slot by accepting, rejecting or cancelling the booking to match.

watchOut: “Update Booking Status” needs a specific anny booking, so keep a booking reference with the Shopify order.
